title: Halo: Combat Evolved
description: Step back onto the ring. The original Halo, reworked to run in your browser.
requirements: Requires your own Halo Xbox XISO image. Select it at the host’s setup prompt. Desktop keyboard and mouse recommended.

title: Black Ops Zombies
description: Kino der Toten, Five, Moon, and more. Pick a map and see how long you can hold the line.
requirements: Desktop keyboard and mouse. Choose a map on the destination page; game assets load after selection.

title: Quake III Arena
description: Rocket jumps, railguns, and arena chaos. Jump into the multiplayer browser port.
requirements: Destination advertises mobile and gamepad support. Desktop keyboard and mouse recommended.

title: CS Surf
description: Forget the firefight. Ride ramps, keep your speed, and chase a cleaner line.
requirements: Desktop keyboard and mouse. Click Play to capture the mouse. Escape opens the menu.

title: Quake
description: The brown corridors. The rocket launcher. Real QuakeWorld multiplayer in your browser.
requirements: Enter a player name and click Play. Desktop keyboard and mouse recommended.

title: Quake II
description: Heavy weapons and industrial arenas. The Quake II multiplayer browser port.
requirements: Choose a player name and click Play. Desktop keyboard and mouse recommended.

title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
description: Storm the beach in the multiplayer browser port of Return to Castle Wolfenstein.
requirements: Desktop Chrome recommended by the host. First load fetches about 380 MB of game data, then caches it.

title: Urban Terror
description: Fast movement meets tactical multiplayer. The ioUrbanTerror engine compiled for the browser.
requirements: Desktop Chrome recommended. Initial game data downloads inside the browser. The supplied link serves Urban Terror, not Unreal Tournament.

title: Half-Life / Counter-Strike 1.6
description: A browser Xash3D launcher for Half-Life and Counter-Strike, with demo and local game-file options.
requirements: Free demo options are available. Full games and mods require files from your own copy. Desktop keyboard and mouse.

title: Halo CE Mobile
description: An unofficial mobile browser adaptation of Halo: Combat Evolved, built around touch controls.
requirements: Choose “Continue in the browser” to skip the optional home-screen installation. Add your own Halo game files when prompted.

title: PES 6
description: The PSP edition of Pro Evolution Soccer 6, recompiled for the browser. Pick your commentary and kick off.
requirements: The host supports keyboard, touch controls, and gamepads. First load fetches game data in the browser.

title: Skate 3 — Fan Game
description: A fan browser project that streams game data from your own converted copy of Skate 3.
requirements: Requires data from your own converted Skate 3 copy. Follow the host’s setup instructions. First load can be slow.

title: GTA: Vice City
description: Neon streets and 1980s Miami. A WebAssembly port with local game-file imports and browser saves.
requirements: Requires your own prepared game.tar.gz archive. Import it once; the host stores game files locally in your browser.

title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
description: Drive straight into Springfield in this native WebAssembly port of Hit & Run.
requirements: Loads game data inside the browser. A desktop browser is recommended; initial loading can take time.

title: Diablo
description: The original dungeon crawl. Try the shareware demo, or bring your own files for the full game.
requirements: Free shareware demo available. The full game requires DIABDAT.MPQ from a copy you own. Desktop recommended.

title: WASM Arcade
description: A browser-game collection featuring GTA III, Vice City, Hit & Run, and Minecraft. Browse the host’s PC games.
requirements: This link opens a collection, rather than a single game. The host recommends a desktop browser and keyboard/mouse or gamepad.
